verdict.rationale: Stripe's Payment Links docs say you can create a payment link and share it on social media, in emails, or on your website, and customers pay in their local language, currency and preferred method. The payment-links and tax pages also describe no-code refunds and no-code tax collection on Payment Links, which implies the no-code flow the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that links are created in the Dashboard, evidence on how quickly a new account can start selling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
